dnrelay build
Run dotnet build and print a compact summary.

Usage:
  dnrelay build <target> [--json] [--timeout <duration>] [--logs-dir <path>] [--env KEY=VALUE] [--env-file <path>] [-- <extra dotnet build args>]
  dnrelay build --target <path> [--json] [--timeout <duration>] [--logs-dir <path>] [--env KEY=VALUE] [--env-file <path>] [-- <extra dotnet build args>]

Arguments:
  <target>      .csproj, .sln, .slnx, or directory to build

Options:
  --target      Explicit target path alias for the positional target
  --json        Emit a final JSON object instead of text summary
  --timeout     Harness timeout, for example 30s, 5m, or 1h
  --logs-dir    Override the harness log directory
  --env         Add or override a process environment variable
  --env-file    Load environment variables from a file
  --            Pass remaining arguments directly to dotnet build

result.stdout:
dnrelay run
Run dotnet run with bounded output and optional pre-build coordination.

Usage:
  dnrelay run [--project <path>|--target <path>] [--no-build] [--raw] [--json] [--timeout <duration>] [--logs-dir <path>] [--env KEY=VALUE] [--env-file <path>] [-- <app args>]

Options:
  --project     Project to run. Defaults to current directory
  --target      Alias for --project
  --no-build    Skip dnrelay's coordinated build phase
  --raw         Stream child stdout/stderr directly to the console
  --json        Emit a final JSON object instead of text summary
  --timeout     Harness timeout, for example 30s, 5m, or 1h
  --logs-dir    Override the harness log directory
  --env         Add or override a process environment variable
  --env-file    Load environment variables from a file
  --            Pass remaining arguments directly to the application

Notes:
  dnrelay run builds under the repo build lock when needed, then runs with --no-build.
  Use top-level --no-build when outputs are already up to date.

result.stdout:
dnrelay bench
Run BenchmarkDotNet with compact progress, summary, and artifact pointers.

Usage:
  dnrelay bench [--project <path>|--target <path>] [--list] [--select <selector>] [-c|--configuration <configuration>] [--json] [--timeout <duration>] [--logs-dir <path>] [--env KEY=VALUE] [--env-file <path>] [-- <benchmark args>]

Options:
  --project           Benchmark project to run. Defaults to current directory
  --target            Alias for --project
  --select            Select a benchmark by index, class name, benchmark name, or filter text
  --list              List discovered benchmarks and exit
  -c, --configuration Build and run configuration. Default is Release
  --json              Emit a final JSON object instead of text summary
  --timeout           Harness timeout, for example 30s, 5m, or 1h
  --logs-dir          Override the harness log directory
  --env               Add or override a process environment variable
  --env-file          Load environment variables from a file
  --                  Pass remaining arguments directly to BenchmarkDotNet

Notes:
  bench builds under the repo build lock, then runs BenchmarkDotNet under a project-scoped bench lock.
  artifacts points to the BenchmarkDotNet.Artifacts directory created by the benchmark project.
  If multiple benchmarks are discovered and you did not pass --select or --filter, bench lists them and exits instead of entering interactive selection.

dnrelay kill
Kill dnrelay-related processes for the current repository.

Usage:
  dnrelay kill <id|*> [--json]

Examples:
  dnrelay stats
  dnrelay kill 12345
  dnrelay kill *

Notes:
  kill uses process ids shown by `dnrelay stats`.
  kill * targets all dnrelay-related processes associated with this repository.
